tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search Remocn Remotion components by what they do. Returns name, docs .md URL, vibe, length (frames @30fps), use/avoid notes and install command.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Full markdown docs for one Remocn component: props, usage example, use/avoid notes and install command.

tools.name: plan_video
tools.description: Turn a video brief into a storyboard: picks an archetype, returns its recipe and a beat list with suggested Remocn components per beat.

tools.name: preview_component
tools.description: Live in-chat preview of a Remocn component with optional props. Also returns its docs URL and install command.
